## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      7 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 2 сент. 2026 г. - 4 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Will_, 4 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Premium is $80 /yr and then they want an additional $99 /yr for meal plans. Crazy expensive."
            2. _Sean Kramer_, 3 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "This app used to be great and stable but a few years ago Private Equity got their greedy hands on it. Now there are bugs galore for normal app functions while simultaneously raising the price for subscriptions to $20/mo. look elsewhere, this is a sinking ship."
            3. _A Yates_, 2 сент. 2026 г., 2/5: "Barcode scanning used to be included and now its locked behind a paywall. Also, there is no reason to include AI in this app. It's a waste of resources."
<!--/ir-theme-->
